title: Taskfold · progress
headline: The agreed P1 batch is complete. Current work is P2.
focus: P2 · Safer subtask storage and moves
latest: The transfer service now moves a subtask and its nested work between personal tasks or within the same team in one transaction, with safe retry and Undo. Both app codebases preserve completion credit through the move and correct it on reopen. Local checks and app builds pass. The move picker and saved recovery flow still need implementation; this feature remains disabled for normal use.
next: Connect typed transfer commands, durable two-task recovery and the destination/review/Undo controls; verify the full native move flow.
Add review and migration tools for older saved work; finish shared-workspace, attachment and discussion preservation.
Verify broader Mac/iPhone/iPad use and larger workloads, then finish the remaining team and audio recovery work. Keep agreed deferrals paused.
